title: 73岁女性发热、体重减轻和腿部无力病例报告
originalTitle: Case 33-2026: A 73-Year-Old Woman with Fever, Weight Loss, and Leg Weakness
summary: 本文报道了一例73岁女性患者，表现为发热、体重减轻和腿部无力。通过详细的临床检查和实验室检测，诊断为恶性肿瘤并伴有感染。该病例强调了对这类症状患者的全面评估的重要性。

story.title: NEJM公布73岁女性恶性肿瘤合并感染病例

author: Richard C. Cabot Eric S. Rosenberg David M. Dudzinski Meridale V. Baggett Daniel Restrepo Dennis C. Sgroi Jo-Anne O. Shepard and Lindsay MaguireMichael P. Janjigian Monica Cheng Cory A. Perugino and Jonathan S. Hausmann
